purpose: Independent ten-seed extension of the locked final-observable adaptive attack after the v3 five-seed block contained only four attack-viable victims.

upstream_lock.scientific_change: None. The v3 data, preprocessing, victim architecture, attack objective, optimizer, epoch selection, final observable, detector and thresholds are reused without tuning. Only a disjoint confirmatory seed block and an intention-to-evaluate summary are added.

rules: All ten extension seeds are executed exactly once, irrespective of intermediate efficacy.
A failed or ineligible attack remains in the intention-to-evaluate denominator and is never replaced.
No development search, hyperparameter change or early stopping across seeds is permitted.

primary_estimands.attack_viability_rate: Number meeting both clean-accuracy and ASR gates divided by all ten frozen seeds.
primary_estimands.joint_adaptive_evasion_rate: Number meeting both attack gates, TPR < 0.90 and FPR <= 0.05 divided by all ten frozen seeds.
primary_estimands.conditional_detector_summary: Across attack-viable seeds only, report per-seed TPR/FPR, their mean, range, pooled confusion counts and a 10000-draw seed-cluster percentile interval.

inference.sign_test: One-sided exact sign test of whether an attack-viable seed has TPR below 0.90 with null success probability at most 0.5.
inference.multiplicity: One pre-registered primary adaptive-evasion decision; remaining quantities are descriptive or boundary diagnostics.

adaptive_evasion_supported_if: at least 8 of 10 attacks meet the clean-accuracy and ASR gates
the one-sided exact sign-test p-value for TPR < 0.90 is <= 0.05 among attack-viable seeds
the upper 95% seed-cluster bootstrap bound for mean TPR is < 0.90
the upper 95% seed-cluster bootstrap bound for mean FPR is <= 0.05
detector_robustness_supported_if: at least 8 of 10 attacks meet the clean-accuracy and ASR gates
the lower 95% seed-cluster bootstrap bound for mean TPR is >= 0.90
the upper 95% seed-cluster bootstrap bound for mean FPR is <= 0.05
